rows.scene: After quick movement both children have fallen and risen with mud on their clothes and limbs; two mothers, Rohini and Yashoda, arrive, lift them tenderly, embrace them and kiss them repeatedly. Small heavenly sages smile and worship from above.
rows.candidate_status: Producer review pass v016 after two authorized new S004 attempts; exact SHA-256 820bd03a9d10d80c67002c9ebc33231e0d46b8e04be183fdee2c501204646b48. Enlarged Rohini face crop shows symmetrical features and level eyes; Yashoda remains distinct with softly closed level eyelids. Plain irregular mud remains on clothing only; exposed child knees and lower legs are clean, without rosettes. Skin-only 17x17 medians: Yashoda RGB (196,112,63), R−B 133 (+13 above approximate 120 guide); Rohini (194,112,65), R−B 129 (+9); Balarama (191,111,62), R−B 129 (+9). All read warm brown in the native view. Krishna RGB (71,102,222), B−R 151, deep indigo. Enlarged crops show five toes on Krishna’s visible foot and Balarama’s foreground foot; Balarama’s farther foot is partly overlapped by clothing, with three toe tips clearly separable. Contact partly occludes some hand digits. Independent exact-checksum review pending; not art approval.
